value.summary: Wiring only - every part exists and is tested.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: "Order: envelope -> endpoints/runner -> enrichment -> search -> proofs -> docs."

value.title: Envelope v1 + error-catalog seed in fs3-core (workshop 004 slice): ok/error/fix/next_action/retryable shapes, FS3-E codes for the errors this plan actually ships; serializer helpers

Daemon endpoints + registration: POST /roots (add path: repo_identity + worktree row + bulk-enqueue scan jobs via snapshot), GET /status (roots, queue depth/states), POST /scan (re-enqueue changed via snapshot diff); CLI verbs add/status/scan as thin envelope clients

Job runner in the daemon: N concurrent claimers (config), claim_job/complete/fail; retry = 3 attempts with not_before backoff (settles queued decision small); scan_file handler = discovery-filtered snapshot entry -> blob bytes -> pure scan -> upsert_element_tree -> enqueue summarize/embed for enrich-marked missing rows (missing_enrichment)

Enrichment handlers through the registry: summarize (tags 1-5) + embed (raw + smart) with per-repo instance resolution (embedder_for/summarizer_for), inline batching + semaphore concurrency from config; Azure + fake arms already exist - snap in azure via ProviderConfig variant per its module recipe

Search v1: daemon GET /search (semantic: embed query via active embedder -> store query_embeddings -> join smart+elements+worktree_files) with --repo/--path/--limit/--min-score/--source; CLI search verb; envelope rows per workshop 003 (address, score, match_field, span, snippet, tags)

End-to-end proofs: (a) CI test - fake provider + throwaway db, fixture mini-repo, scan->enrich->search assertions + idempotent-rescan-zero-enrichment; (b) LIVE run - daemon scans ONLY the isolated fixture corpus (crates/parsers/fixtures or an equivalent small root; never a whole repo - cost ruling) via Azure, 3 questions, transcript to assets/first-light-run.md with row counts + spend-relevant call counts
Docs: docs/services/first-light.md (what wired where, verify commands) + README quickstart section update

Schema-version discipline (Jordan ruling: dogfood doctor early): fs3_store::schema_current(pool) fast check (embedded MIGRATOR vs _sqlx_migrations); EVERY db-touching daemon endpoint + CLI-reachable path runs it and rejects stale with FS3-E-STORE-SCHEMA-STALE fix='run flowspace3 doctor'; minimal `flowspace3 doctor` verb v1 = schema slice only (report + APPLY migrations automatically — no second command), envelope output; daemon boot migration stays as-is

tk-0101.assertion: envelope unit tests green; every error carries code+fix; catalog drift test (code without docs row fails) seeded

tk-0102.assertion: curl POST /roots with a path -> worktree row + pending scan jobs; flowspace3 add/status print envelopes; bad path -> FS3-E code with fix

tk-0103.assertion: runner drains a seeded queue concurrently; a failing job retries 3x with backoff then fails with last_error; scan_file on a fixture repo produces the exact expected element rows

tk-0104.assertion: enrichment fills smart_content (valid tag band) + both embedding rows for enrich-marked elements; per-repo override proven by a test with two repos on different fake instances

tk-0105.assertion: search over the fixture corpus returns known-relevant element first; filters narrow candidates in SQL; envelope validates

tk-0106.assertion: CI e2e green incl. zero-enrichment rescan; live transcript committed with timings + the 3 Q&A
live Azure run recorded against the fixture-subset root only (registry-resolved, Entra); transcript notes element/summary/embedding row counts and provider call counts

tk-0107.assertion: docs page exists w/ verify commands; README quickstart runs as written

tk-0108.assertion: with a deliberately behind db, any db-touching command returns FS3-E-STORE-SCHEMA-STALE naming doctor; `flowspace3 doctor` applies the missing migrations and the same command then succeeds — proven as a test
